name: Sydney Winter Sunday 2022
information:
#### Registration for this competition has closed and the waiting list is full. Please consider one of our [upcoming competitions in New South Wales](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?utf8=%E2%9C%93&region=all&search=New+South+Wales&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)

This is a **series competition** alonside Sydney Winter Saturday 2022. **You will be permitted to compete at ONLY ONE of the two competitions.** If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each day has a slightly different set of events.
